5 تخوّق It (an earring, TA) was, or became, wide, or widened. (K.) [See also 7.] ―
-b2- تخوّق عَنْهُ He went, retired, or withdrew himself, far away from him, or it. (K, * TA.) And He left, quitted, or forsook, it; namely, a course that he desired, or meant, to pursue. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
